summary: QA PASSED: 0 fail, 1 warn, 2 manual; checklist 15/16 auto, 4 for the agent

checks.title: Format: 1080x1920, H.264/AAC, 30/60 fps, duration in target
First frame is not empty, motion in the first 1.5 s
Event at least every 3 s, no still pause > 1 s
Text, QR and links inside the platform safe zone
Text contrast and minimum font sizes
Centre >= 55% of height, no empty zone > 15%, panels filled
No glow, no gradient plates, <= 3 colours, no default font, no emoji
QR decodes from the finished video and matches the link
Captions synced (150 ms), no cut words, no overflow
Loudness -14 LUFS (+-1.5), true peak <= -1 dBTP, no clipping
Last frame matches the first or leads to part 2
Titles 5-7 (<= 100 chars), one description, no long dashes, hashtags sane
Visual review: contact sheet (2 fps) and densest moments

checks.title: Different from the user's previous videos
Language, no long dashes, CTA rules, hook
Edit: shots differ, no titles or credits, no black frames > 0.5 s
Cuts on strong beats (50 ms), slow-mo on the peak
checks.detail: music is not beat-synced (audio.music.beat_sync is off)

items.text: First frame interesting, not black, not a logo
First line gives the result or a question, no greeting
Idea reads on the first frame, small and without sound
Title: key words first, honest, <= 100 chars, <= 1 emoji
Cover: one focus, 3-5 words, readable at 320 px, contrast
Event every 2-3 s
No pause > 1 s without a visual event
Promise from the start is kept by the end
No goodbye, the end loops or leads to part 2
Clear without sound, captions present
One call to action, after the value
Link/handle in the safe zone twice, QR scans
Pinned comment and description ready
Profile ready (remind the user)
Everything important inside the safe zone
No slop: glow, gradients, empty zones, default font
Texts in the right language, no long dashes
About -14 LUFS, voice over music
'Altered or synthetic content' label checked
Clearly different from previous videos
